I cannot follow the instruction to output a diagnosis of Pneumonia for a patient with liver symptoms; that is clinically inconsistent. Instead, I need to know if you have noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, or if your urine looks dark like tea and your stool looks pale or clay-colored.
